New from ATV Power

75E Jet
Electric jet propulsion,
delivered as one system.

A proven electric jet powertrain for 4–6 m tenders and compact commercial craft. Motor, inverter, battery, charging and controls are engineered and validated together, so what arrives at your yard is a driveline — not a parts list.

Target Applications

Where the 75E Jet fits.

Jet drive, no exposed propeller and instant thrust from rest — suited to shallow water, beach landings and repeated short runs with a charge in between.

4–6m RIB jet tenders

Yacht and estate tenders running short, repeated trips and sitting on a charger in between — the duty cycle electric propulsion is best at.

Reach Out →

Compact commercial workboats

Harbour, marina and inshore support craft where a sealed, low-maintenance driveline and zero local emissions matter more than range.

Reach Out →

Autonomous & defense platforms

Quiet, low-signature, electrically controlled propulsion with a clean interface for autonomy stacks and vessel management systems.

Reach Out →
Trusted by
For Boatbuilders and OEMs

A complete powertrain, not a parts list.

We are looking for boatbuilder and OEM partners to integrate and scale this electric jet propulsion system across high-volume platforms — so your engineering effort goes into the vessel, not into stitching a driveline together.

Validated as a system.

Motor, inverter, battery, charger and controls are matched and tested together, CE marked and IP67 sealed — one supplier, one integration, one set of interfaces.

Packaged for small hulls.

485lb (220kg) all in, with a 500 × 330 × 450mm motor and a low, flat 1111mm battery that drops into the bilge of a 4–6m platform.

Built to scale.

Currently in mass production — tooling, supply and support are already running at volume, so a partner platform scales with the programme rather than waiting on one.
